name: mstack-backlog-triage
description: Triage a tracker's open issues into now, next and defer with evidence: read every issue in full, classify each (bug with or without a reproduction, feature, chore, duplicate, not actionable), require a duplicate search before anything goes in the current batch, route items to mstack-write-specs or mstack-diagnose, and output a table the mstack review workflows accept. Drafts comments and label changes, and posts only text the user approved word for word. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Sort open issues into now, next and defer, with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Reads every open issue with its comments, proves the list is complete, checks each for duplicates including closed issues, classifies it with evidence, and recommends now, next or defer within the batch size the user sets. Issues that need a spec or a diagnosis are routed to those skills. Comments and label changes are drafted and posted only after the user approves the exact text.
